# Spotify for Developers

> > Official documentation and resources for building applications with the Spotify Web API and platform SDKs

Spotify for Developers provides comprehensive documentation for integrating Spotify's music streaming capabilities into applications. The platform offers Web API access for metadata and playback control, mobile SDKs for iOS, OAuth authentication, and community support for developers building on the Spotify ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Spotify Web API
- iOS SDK
- OAuth Authentication
- Playback Control
- Web API
- Mobile Development
- Spotify Premium
- API Documentation
- SDK Documentation
- Getting Started
- Xcode
- GitHub
- Developer Community
- Platform Security
- Offline Support

## Web API Documentation

- [Web API](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api): Web API docs for accessing Spotify metadata and playback control

## Mobile SDK Documentation

- [iOS SDK](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ios): iOS SDK docs for integrating Spotify playback into mobile apps

## Community & Support

- [Community](https://developer.spotify.com/community): Developer community forum for Spotify API discussions and updates
